name: Broken Limbs Don't Heal
teaser: Broken limbs aren't supposed to heal instantly. This mod introduces a new health effect and mechanic for that.
description:
A simple mod that will make healing fractures act a bit differently (more in a realistic way, some sort).

Once you break your leg/arm and heal it with a splint, or a surgery kit, you’ll get a “Healed Fracture” - an effect that’d still give you slight debuffs for movement speed, and ergonomics.

Penalties also stack with each healed arm/leg, effectively doubling the penalties. Both penalties % and time are configurable inside F12!

Powered by EFT Effects Manager

And is more of a showcase mod of what’s possible to add into the game using this API. However, suggestions and bug reports are always welcome.
